title: Manner in which complaint shall be made
text: A consumer complaint may be filed with the District Commission by a consumer, an authorized voluntary consumer association, or groups of consumers sharing a common interest.
keywords: consumer complaint defective product refund service invoice warranty district commission ग्राहक शिकायत

title: Jurisdiction of District Commission
text: The District Commission exercises jurisdiction over consumer claims where the value of goods or services paid does not exceed fifty lakh rupees, filed where the complainant resides or the opposite party works.
keywords: consumer district commission jurisdiction seller complainant residence pecuniary limit पचास लाख

title: Deficiency in service
text: Deficiency covers any fault, imperfection, shortcoming or inadequacy in the quality, nature and manner of performance required by law or contract in relation to any service.
keywords: deficiency service airline flight cancellation bank unauthorized charges hospital insurance claim delay सेवा में कमी

title: Unfair trade practice
text: Unfair trade practices include making false representations about warranty, refusing to issue cash receipts, or failing to refund money when goods or services are defective or not provided as promised.
keywords: unfair trade practice refund refusal false warranty misleading advertisement hidden charges अनुचित व्यापार

title: Findings and relief by District Commission
text: Where defect or deficiency is established, the Commission may direct the seller to remove defects, replace goods, return the price with interest, pay compensation for loss, or award punitive damages.
keywords: consumer relief refund interest compensation replacement damages क्षतिपूर्ति हर्जाना

title: Request for obtaining information
text: A person seeking information from a public authority may submit an application in writing or electronically to the Central or State Public Information Officer specifying the details requested.
keywords: rti information public authority pio application records rti fees आरटीआई सूचना अधिकार

title: Disposal of request and timelines
text: The Public Information Officer must provide information or reject the request within thirty days. If the information concerns the life or liberty of a person, it must be provided within forty-eight hours.
keywords: rti response deadline thirty days 30 days life liberty 48 hours तीस दिन

title: Appeals against PIO decision
text: A requester who does not receive a decision within the statutory timeline or is aggrieved by a refusal may file a First Appeal within thirty days to a senior designated officer, followed by a Second Appeal to the Information Commission.
keywords: rti appeal first appeal second appeal cic sic non response rejection प्रथम अपील

title: Information in cognizable cases and FIR
text: Information relating to a cognizable offence may be reported to a police station orally or by electronic communication (e-FIR). The police must register an FIR irrespective of jurisdiction (Zero FIR).
keywords: fir zero fir police cognizable offence complaint electronic fir complaint police station प्रथम सूचना रिपोर्ट पुलिस शिकायत

title: Magistrate order for police investigation
text: Where a police officer in charge refuses to register an FIR and the Superintendent of Police fails to act, an aggrieved complainant may approach the Judicial Magistrate seeking directions to investigate.
keywords: police refusal fir not registered magistrate application 156 3 investigation order पुलिस इनकार मजिस्ट्रेट

title: Notice of appearance before police officer
text: For offences punishable with imprisonment of seven years or less, a police officer shall issue a notice of appearance directing the person to appear before the officer instead of arresting them immediately.
keywords: notice of appearance 41a arrest protection police notice interrogation गिरफ़्तारी नोटिस

title: Cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property
text: Deceiving any person fraudulently or dishonestly to induce delivery of property, money, or to alter valuable securities constitutes criminal cheating, punishable with imprisonment up to seven years and fine.
keywords: cheating fraud money scam upi payment deceit financial loss 420 bns धोखाधड़ी जालसाजी

title: Criminal breach of trust
text: Whoever is entrusted with property or dominion over property and dishonestly misappropriates, converts to their own use, or uses it in violation of law or contract commits criminal breach of trust.
keywords: criminal breach of trust misappropriation security deposit withheld agency partner अमानत में खयानत

title: Criminal intimidation
text: Threatening another person with injury to their person, reputation, or property with intent to cause alarm or force them to act against their legal will constitutes criminal intimidation.
keywords: threat intimidation harassment blackmail abusive messages call threat जान से मारने की धमकी

title: Stalking and cyber stalking
text: Following, contacting, or attempting to contact a woman repeatedly despite disinterest, or monitoring her internet, email, or electronic communication constitutes stalking.
keywords: stalking cyber stalking harassment online messages unwanted calls पीछा करना

title: Admissibility of electronic records
text: Electronic records including WhatsApp messages, emails, digital transactions, and device logs are admissible as documentary evidence when authenticated with certificate or primary device records.
keywords: evidence electronic record whatsapp chat screenshot upi payment email proof 65b digital evidence साक्ष्य व्हाट्सएप स्क्रीनशॉट

title: Obligation of parties to perform contracts
text: The parties to a contract must perform or offer to perform their respective promises unless performance is dispensed with or excused under the provisions of the contract or applicable law.
keywords: contract agreement obligation tenant landlord deposit terms refund clause संविदा दायित्व

title: Compensation for loss or damage caused by breach
text: When a contract is broken, the party suffering the breach is entitled to receive compensation from the defaulting party for any loss or damage naturally arising from such breach in the usual course of things.
keywords: contract breach compensation damages refund penalty loss recovery हर्जाना नुकसान

title: Compensation for breach where penalty stipulated
text: When a contract contains a penalty clause or fixed forfeiture amount, the aggrieved party is entitled to reasonable compensation not exceeding the named amount, without needing to prove actual loss.
keywords: penalty deduction security deposit forfeiture arbitrary cut clause अनुचित कटौती

title: Duration of certain leases in absence of written contract
text: A lease of immovable property for residential or non-manufacturing purposes is deemed month-to-month, terminable by either party with fifteen days' written notice.
keywords: lease notice 15 days notice tenancy termination vacating flat notice period पट्टा नोटिस

title: Maintenance of property and reasonable wear and tear
text: The lessee is bound to keep and restore the property in as good condition as it was when possessed, subject to reasonable wear and tear or irresistible force.
keywords: wear and tear maintenance property painting charges cleaning deposit deduction landlord tenant टूट-फूट मकान रखरखाव

title: Exemption of premises with monthly rent over ₹3,500
text: The Delhi Rent Control Act does not apply to any premises whose monthly rent exceeds three thousand five hundred rupees, which are instead governed by the Transfer of Property Act and civil remedies.
keywords: delhi rent control drc monthly rent 3500 threshold jurisdiction civil suit किराया नियंत्रण

title: Return of amount and compensation for delayed possession
text: If a builder fails to complete or give possession of an apartment or plot in accordance with the agreement for sale, the buyer may demand a full refund with interest and compensation.
keywords: builder delay possession flat rera refund interest compensation builder fraud फ्लैट कब्जा बिल्डर देरी

title: Duty to produce driving licence and vehicle documents
text: The driver or owner of a motor vehicle is required to produce vehicle registration, insurance, pollution certificates, and driving licence when demanded by an authorized police or transport officer.
keywords: traffic challan license rc insurance puc police checking vehicle documents चालान ड्राइविंग लाइसेंस

title: Compounding of certain traffic offences
text: Designated traffic offences may be compounded by the payment of specified sums before or after the institution of prosecution, including via designated virtual courts and online challan payment gateways.
keywords: e-challan virtual court compounding fine traffic payment dispute echallan चालान भुगतान

title: Driving by a drunken person or under influence of drugs
text: Driving or attempting to drive with alcohol exceeding 30 mg per 100 ml of blood detected by a breath analyser is punishable with imprisonment up to six months, a fine up to ten thousand rupees, or both.
keywords: drunk driving breath analyser alcohol blood test traffic fine शराब पीकर गाड़ी

title: Dishonour of cheque for insufficiency of funds
text: Where a cheque drawn for discharge of a debt or liability is returned unpaid by the bank due to insufficient funds, the drawer is liable for imprisonment up to two years or fine up to twice the cheque amount.
keywords: cheque bounce dishonour cheque insufficient funds cheque notice 138 ni act चेक बाउंस

title: Cognizance of cheque dishonour offences and notice
text: A complaint under Section 138 must be filed within one month after the payee gives written demand notice within thirty days of dishonour and the drawer fails to pay within fifteen days of notice receipt.
keywords: 138 notice statutory notice 15 days 30 days limitation cheque complaint चेक नोटिस मियाद

title: Cheating by personation by using computer resource
text: Whoever by means of any communication device or computer resource cheats by personating another person commits an offence punishable with imprisonment up to three years and fine up to one lakh rupees.
keywords: cyber fraud upi scam otp fraud phishing fake profile identity cheat ऑनलाइन धोखाधड़ी साइबर ठगी

title: Punishment for violation of privacy
text: Intentionally capturing, publishing, or transmitting the image of a private area of any person without consent under circumstances violating privacy is punishable with imprisonment up to three years or fine.
keywords: privacy violation private images photos leaked without consent blackmail cyber crime निजता का उल्लंघन

act: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005
title: Application to Magistrate for relief
text: An aggrieved woman or Protection Officer may apply to the Magistrate for one or more reliefs under the Act, including protection orders, residence orders, monetary relief, and custody orders.
keywords: domestic violence cruelty maintenance residence order magistrate application घरेलू हिंसा

act: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005
title: Residence orders
text: The Magistrate may pass a residence order restraining the respondent from dispossessing the aggrieved person from the shared household or directing the respondent to secure alternate accommodation.
keywords: shared household right to reside eviction protection domestic residence order आवास का अधिकार

title: Claims arising out of deductions from wages or delay in payment
text: An employee whose wages have been delayed or subjected to unauthorized deductions may apply to the designated Authority for an order directing refund and statutory compensation.
keywords: unpaid salary delayed wages salary deduction employment employer wage dispute वेतन बकाया
